_meta._note: THREE independent navigation definitions exist. All preserved — none is authoritative over the others.
_meta._warning: site.nav and Footer.explore are separate hardcoded lists with different shapes and different link sets.

primaryNav._consumedBy: Header.tsx desktop nav and mobile menu

servicesDropdown._note: DERIVED at runtime from the services collection — not a hardcoded list.
servicesDropdown.sourceFileComment: Titles only. The durations read as a ragged second column here — they belong on the service card, not in a ten-row menu.
servicesDropdown._note2: The Services trigger is a <button>, so this dropdown footer link is the ONLY desktop route to /services.

logo._altNote: Empty alt — decorative, because the wordmark text sits beside it

wordmark._warning: HARDCODED as two separate spans at Header.tsx:187 and :190. Does NOT read from site.name or site.shortName. An admin changing the business name would NOT change the header.

mobileMenu._note: Renders only top-level nav items with a zero-padded index (01, 02, ...). Sub-lists are deliberately omitted — source comment: 'the Services and Media sub-lists would swamp a phone screen; they live on their own pages.'

behaviour._note: Design behaviour recorded for completeness — NOT to be changed (owner decision D-010)
behaviour.readingProgressBar: Fills left-to-right across the header, visible only when scrolled

breadcrumbs._note: Rendered visually on 7 pages. NO BreadcrumbList structured data is emitted.
breadcrumbs._hrefNote: On /gallery and /videos the 'Media' crumb links to /gallery (there is no /media route).

legalPages._note: There is no /privacy, no /terms, no cookie notice and no legal navigation anywhere in the frontend. The appointment form's consent checkbox links to nothing. Recorded as a fact, not invented.
legalPages.privacyPolicy: UNKNOWN — CURRENT FRONTEND DOES NOT PROVIDE THIS
